+def make_response(content, status=200, content_type=None):
+    response = requests.Response()
+    response.status_code = status
+    response._content = content
+    if content_type:
+        response.headers['Content-Type'] = content_type
+        response.encoding = requests.utils.get_encoding_from_headers(response.headers)
+    return response
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_passes_options_and_decodes_utf8(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+
+    def get(url, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((url, kwargs))
+        return make_response('café'.encode('utf-8'), content_type='text/plain')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', get)
+    response = get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org', headers={'X-Test': 'yes'}, timeout=3)
+
+    assert response.text == 'café'
+    assert calls == [('https://example.org', {'headers': {'X-Test': 'yes'}, 'timeout': 3})]
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_honors_declared_charset(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', lambda *args, **kwargs:
+                        make_response(b'caf\xe9', content_type='text/plain; charset=iso-8859-1'))
+
+    assert get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org').text == 'café'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('status', [403, 404, 416])
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_raises_terminal_http_errors(monkeypatch, status):
+    calls = []
+
+    def get(*args, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(None)
+        return make_response(b'', status=status)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', get)
+    with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.HTTPError) as error:
+        get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org')
+
+    assert error.value.response.status_code == status
+    assert len(calls) == 1
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_retries_other_http_errors(monkeypatch):
+    responses = iter([make_response(b'', status=500), make_response(b'ok')])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', lambda *args, **kwargs: next(responses))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia, 'sleep', lambda seconds: None)
+
+    assert get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org').content == b'ok'
+
+
